recommendation.directSunIntensityNote: Source Blender sun energy is 3.5 W/m2-like irradiance; Babylon standard PBR intensity is not a physical unit equivalence. Start 3.5 and tune after IBL at 1 using neutral grey/white surfaces.
recommendation.hdrUse: HDRCubeTexture with gammaSpace=false and prefiltering; source world strength is already included.
recommendation.backgroundUse: sky.jpg is the same render with original AgX Medium High Contrast and exposure applied. Do not apply display tonemapping twice to the JPEG.
recommendation.sunDiscNote: Original source sky has sun_disc=false; a separate directional light is required and avoids duplicate sun in IBL.

photoDome.reason: PhotoDome otherwise selects MIRRORED_MODE. Override to retain canonical u=atan2(z,x)/(2*pi)+0.5 orientation.
photoDome.imageProcessing: Disable additional tone mapping on JPEG background material, exposure 1, contrast 1.

recommendation.preferredBackground: Use the same linear HDRCubeTexture for a skybox to apply scene tonemapping exactly once. sky.jpg is supplied for a lightweight PhotoDome fallback.

orientationVerification: Independent 256x128 panorama with RGB emissive markers confirmed native +X at u=.498, native -Z at u=.248, native +Y at top, within half a source pixel.
